name: Ben-Hesed
title: Solomon's Overseer in Arubboth
summary: Ben-Hesed was one of Solomon's twelve overseers, responsible for Arubboth, Sokoh and all the land of Hepher.

keyEvents.title: Overseer under Solomon
keyEvents.description: Ben-Hesed was in charge of Arubboth, Sokoh and the land of Hepher among Solomon's overseers.
